messages:
sam-runtime: heads-up — after the kernel-selection tweak landed in canary we see a ~15% host CPU increase and more tcp write stalls. looks tied to bursts of short requests where tokenization + preparse dominates.

maria-ml: ugh. any flamegraphs? allocation profile? maybe new kernel choice increases host-side prep for short seqs

sam-runtime: attaching quick profile summary: sampled for 60s during a steady 600 rps of short-chat workloads — host time went from 120ms -> 145ms p95. top hot funcs: preparse::tokenize_worker, grpc::writev, http2::frame_serialize

jonah-sre: can you repro locally? curious if grpc small-write coalescing regressed. also check kvcache hit rate — spikes in miss rate will amplify preparse work

nina-eng: i dug into traces — when batch sizes drop below 4, we start draining kv-cache and fall into a slower windowing path. That plus the new kernel choice amplifies the host parse overhead per-request. might be kvcache eviction churn.

sam-runtime: repro command below (small local harness):
```
./bench_client --model rwd-3b --seq 32 --rps 600 --burst 50 --streaming
```
reproduce with canary build tag r2024-11-kernel-select

maria-ml: quick experiment: force kernel A for seq<=64 and keep kernel B for long ones. on microbench that reduced host p95 by ~10% for short seqs. suggests kernel-selection policy needs a perf-aware heuristic.

jonah-sre: also try bumping GRPC_WRITEV_THRESHOLD to 8k on the proxy to force coalescing for our small frames. that reduced syscall counts a lot in my local tests. tradeoff is latency tail for large payloads.

nina-eng: proposed heuristic:
- prefer kernel-A when seq <= 64 and expected kv-hit-rate >= 0.7
- if realtime batching < 6, enable proto-slim parsing path
- coalesce stream chunks for requests < 2KB until socket idle 2ms

sam-runtime: nice. i can send a canary patch with kernel selector + proto-slim toggles. also will add a kv-hit tracer to the runtime so we can correlate misses with host spikes.

ci-bot: rollout paused on canary r2024-11-kernel-select due to CPU regression alert :warning:

maria-ml: put up an A/B in console: kernel-policy=old vs kernel-policy=heuristic, attach p95 tokenization and grpc write syscall counters. i'll own analysis.

jonah-sre: i'll add a perf job (linux perf + uprobe) for both policies and collect flamegraphs across 10-minute runs.

nina-eng: i have a tiny patch for proto-slim — diff snippet:
```
- parse_full(msg)
+ if likely_short(msg): parse_slim(msg)
```
will open PR and tag @sam-runtime

sam-runtime: thanks — will follow up with canary runs and perf links here once tests complete. :thumbsup:
